subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team Members, I am excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday at the local park. We have a fun-filled day planned with team-building activities, games, and a delicious BBQ lunch. Please RSVP by the end of this week so we can finalize the arrangements. Looking forward to a great day of bonding and camaraderie! Best regards, [Your Name]
